name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=animate, descriptor=spell_impact_per_target). Accurately names the behavior: a per-spell impact animation drawn over each target tile. No address residue. The numeric IDs referenced inside (spell_id 0x08/0x09/0x12/0x13/0x16/0x19) are real spell IDs (verified vs fd2-knowledge: 0x16=封咒術, 0x19=行動術, 0x09=咒殺術) and stay in the comment, not the name.
purpose: Plays the most-used per-spell impact animation, drawing each animation frame's sprite over every in-window target tile while firing per-spell SFX hooks.
logic_summary: Copies three parallel per-spell byte tables (sprite-offset @0x51F33, frame-count @0x51F54, sfx-frame @0x51F75) into local 33-byte scratch buffers. mallocs a 0x25680 preserve buffer and snapshots the live back-buffer into it (printf+exit on OOM). For each frame 0..frame_count_tbl[spell_id]-1: restores the clean baseline back-buffer from the preserve buffer; computes the frame sprite address via the portrait sheet's offset table (entry [6+(sprite_off+frame)*4]); for each target index in char_idx_array whose runtime-char pos_x/pos_y falls inside the battle view window, blits the frame sprite at the tile's screen offset (row stride 0x2ac0, col stride 0x18, +0x75d8); flushes the composite to the mode13h primary; runs the SFX hook (frame 0 fires sfx_frame_tbl[spell_id] when non-zero, plus a per-spell dispatch chain that fires extra SFX on specific frames: 0x16/f7->3, 0x19/f3,f6->5, 0x12/f4->7, 0x13/f3,f6->8, 0x08/f3,f6->10, 0x09/f15,f19->0xf); then one BIOS-tick timing pulse. Frees the preserve buffer and finalizes with fd2_composite_battle_frame(0).
signature: void __cdecl fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target(uint32 param_1, uint32 spell_id, uint32 target_count, uint32 char_idx_array)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Caster runtime-char index. Callers pass caster_idx but the body never reads it; only forwarded to the __CHK stack-probe.
params.reason: Generic placeholder name. Callers (e.g. fd2_apply_attack_spell_damage @0x2111a) pass caster_idx; renaming to caster_idx reflects the actual argument and removes the param_N placeholder. Rename deferred to Stage 2 (touches signature/protos).

params.name: spell_id
params.semantics: Spell ID, index 0..35 into the three per-spell byte tables and the SFX special-case dispatch.
params.reason: Accurate domain name; matches use as the table/dispatch index.

params.name: target_count
params.semantics: Number of entries in char_idx_array (the target overlay loop bound).
params.reason: Accurate; names the loop count over the target array.

params.name: char_idx_array
params.semantics: Pointer to a byte array of runtime-char indices to overlay the animation onto (cast to uint8* in the body).
params.reason: Accurate; describes the byte index array indexed by tgt_iter.

returns.semantics: No return value; performs the animation as a side effect (renders frames, plays SFX, leaves a final composite).

comment_original_issue: Pre-existing comment block was accurate and precise. Minor refinement only: the param_1 line said 'unused by the body' without noting that callers pass caster_idx; augmented that one line to record the caller semantics.
notes: Caller fd2_apply_attack_spell_damage @0x2111a confirms arg order (caster_idx, spell_id, target_count, p_target_ids). Disassembly confirms param_1 is loaded only via __CHK; EBP=spell_id drives the table index and SFX dispatch; window check uses origin/max globals. The decompiler's exit(anim_frame_count_tbl._0_4_) is an artifact of the shared printf+exit epilogue jump (0001c534 PUSH 0x50195; JMP 0x10056); src uses exit(1), the standard OOM idiom -- equivalent, not a logic concern. Ghidra plate enumerates the SFX special-cases while src summarizes them; both consistent, plate left unchanged. write to large_game_state_buffer is via memmove restore each frame plus the per-target blit base.
